name: Receive Audio
author: HamDash
description: The receive-audio engine the Rig Control card plays through. Retired as a card of its own: Listen is at the foot of the rig card now.

device.label: Audio input
device.help: 'mock' is a test tone, so the card works with no radio attached - and it is the default for that reason. 'rig' follows the audio input set on the active radio, which is usually what you want once there is one; change radios and the audio moves with it. The rest are this machine's own inputs.

rate.label: Quality
rate.help: Samples per second sent to the browser. A receiver's audio is about 3 kHz wide, so 8000 carries all of it at 128 kbit/s; 12000 leaves headroom and costs 192. Higher is only worth it on a wired network.

buffer_ms.label: Buffer (ms)
buffer_ms.help: How much audio to hold before playing, to ride out network jitter. Lower is more responsive; raise it if you hear dropouts. 120 ms is comfortable on a LAN, 300+ on patchy Wi-Fi.
